purpose: Build one deterministic float32 input cache to the pretrained UNICOM B/16 final transformer block for a train-only matched representation screen
rows: all 59,551 official SOP TRAIN images in source-archive order; no official test image bytes
cache: shape (59551,196,768), float32 .npy, canonical authenticated UNICOM evaluation transform, frozen prefix through block 10 inclusive
validation: for every row, replay block 11, norm and original output head from cached tokens; require normalized cosine with authenticated source descriptor at least 0.99999; record minimum cosine, maximum absolute descriptor difference, data SHA-256, wall time, peak CUDA allocation and host RSS
next_use: the same immutable cache will feed all matched SOP train-only head/tail and ArcFace/teacher arms; it is not a live inference timing benchmark
